newsitem.title: GREECE: Turkish helicopter crashes, crew missing - reports.
newsitem.headline: Turkish helicopter crashes, crew missing - reports.

text.p: A Turkish military helicopter crashed near Greece's eastern island of Rhodes on Tuesday and the four crew members were missing and presumed dead, Greek radio stations reported.
The helicopter crashed in the sea about 35 miles (55 km) southwest of Rhodes and just off the Turkish coast, the radios said. The crash occurred at about three a.m. (0100 GMT).
The radios said the helicopter was attached to NATO naval forces in the Mediterranean.
The U.S. Navy frigate Bradley was at the scene, they added.
The Greek Defence Ministry was unable to confirm the crash immediately.
The helicopter appeared to be in international waters, the radios said.
They said the helicopter was visible on the surface of the water and three crew members could be seen trapped inside. They appeared to be dead. A fourth crew member was believed to have been aboard.
Greece and Turkey have tense relations in their Aegean and Mediterranean border regions. In January, they came close to war over an uninhabited island.
